remoteClasses.name: MoqPublisherEndpoint

constructor.doc: Create an endpoint that publishes media to a MoQ relay. Connect a media source and call publish() to start publishing.

params.name: url
params.doc: MoQ relay URL to publish to, including the scheme required by the relay (for example, https://relay.example.com).

params.name: broadcast
params.doc: Name under which the relay announces this broadcast. Subscribers must use the same name (for example, my-stream.hang).

properties.name: url
properties.doc: URL of the MoQ relay configured for this endpoint.

properties.name: broadcast
properties.doc: Name of the broadcast configured for this endpoint.

methods.name: publish
methods.doc: Start encoding connected audio/video media and publishing it to the configured relay and broadcast. Call this after connecting the media source.

methods.name: unpublish
methods.doc: Stop publishing and close the connection to the MoQ relay.
